title: Benjie Goes to Space
cast: bnjyboy is a cheerful boy in a white astronaut spacesuit with a round clear helmet and blue boots. He is the ONLY person in this story and he is always alone. His rocket is a cardboard box painted silver with a round window and little fins.
keep: bnjyboy in a white astronaut spacesuit with a round clear helmet. Exactly ONE child in the picture, alone. No other people.

p1.text: Benjie found a big cardboard box. It was taller than he was. He knew just what to do.
p1.art: bnjyboy standing beside a very big cardboard box in a sunny back garden, looking up at it with a huge grin.

p2.text: He painted it silver all over. He drew a round window. He added three little fins.
p2.art: bnjyboy painting the big cardboard box silver in the garden, a round window drawn on the front and three paper fins taped to the bottom.

p3.text: He put on his space helmet. He climbed inside the rocket. He counted down from three.
p3.art: bnjyboy in a white spacesuit and round clear helmet climbing into the silver cardboard rocket in the garden.

p4.text: Three. Two. One. The rocket rumbled and shook. Then up it went!
p4.art: The little silver cardboard rocket lifting off from the garden in a puff of white smoke, bnjyboy waving from the round window.

p5.text: The Earth got small below him. It looked blue and swirly. Two things waited ahead.
p5.art: bnjyboy's silver rocket high above a small blue and white Earth, deep starry space all around, the Moon on one side and a bright comet on the other.

a1.text: The Moon got bigger and bigger. It was grey and dusty. It had holes all over it.
a1.art: bnjyboy's silver rocket flying toward a big grey Moon covered in round craters, stars behind.

a2.text: He landed with a soft bump. Grey dust puffed up. He hopped down very slowly.
a2.art: bnjyboy in his spacesuit hopping down from the little silver rocket onto grey moon dust, a puff of dust around his boots.

a3.text: His boots made deep footprints. A wide crater sat one way. A little flag stood the other.
a3.art: bnjyboy standing on the grey Moon between a wide round crater on one side and a small stiff flag planted in the dust on the other.

b1.text: The comet had a long tail. It was silver and sparkly. Benjie flew along beside it.
b1.art: bnjyboy's silver rocket flying alongside a bright comet with a long sparkling silver tail across deep space.

b2.text: Tiny bits of ice floated past. They tapped on his window. It sounded like soft rain.
b2.art: Small glittering ice crystals drifting past the round window of the rocket, bnjyboy peering out at them delighted.

b3.text: The comet swept past two places. One had bright rings. One was full of stars.
b3.art: The comet's tail sweeping between a planet with wide bright rings on one side and a glowing cloud of coloured stars on the other.

aa1.text: The crater was deep and round. Its walls were steep and grey. It was very, very quiet.
aa1.art: bnjyboy in his spacesuit standing at the rim of a deep round crater on the Moon, looking down into it.

aa2.text: Something glowed at the bottom. It was soft and blue. It blinked slowly at him.
aa2.art: A soft blue glow coming from the bottom of the dark moon crater, bnjyboy leaning over the edge to see.

aa3.text: He had a torch in his pocket. He could shine it down. Or he could climb down himself.
aa3.art: bnjyboy at the crater rim holding a small torch in one hand, a rope of moon rock leading down into the dark.

ab1.text: The flag was old and stiff. It did not flap at all. There is no wind on the Moon.
ab1.art: bnjyboy standing beside a small stiff flag planted in grey moon dust, no wind, stars above.

ab2.text: Beside it sat a little rover. It had six small wheels. One light was still blinking.
ab2.art: A small six-wheeled metal rover sitting in the moon dust beside the flag, one little light blinking, bnjyboy crouching to look.

ab3.text: The rover beeped twice at him. It wanted to show him something. Or maybe it needed help.
ab3.art: The little rover turning its camera toward bnjyboy, one wheel stuck crookedly in the dust.

ba1.text: The rings were made of ice. Millions of pieces spun round. They shone like glass.
ba1.art: bnjyboy's rocket approaching a huge planet with wide rings made of glittering ice pieces, deep space behind.

ba2.text: He flew slowly through them. Ice floated all around. Some pieces were bigger than his rocket.
ba2.art: The little silver rocket drifting between enormous glittering ice boulders inside the planet's rings, bnjyboy amazed at the window.

ba3.text: A tiny moon spun below. The rings sparkled all around. Both looked worth a closer look.
ba3.art: A small round moon spinning below the ring system, the bright icy rings arcing overhead, the rocket hovering between them.

bb1.text: Stars drifted past like snow. Some were pink. Some were blue.
bb1.art: bnjyboy's rocket floating inside a glowing cloud of pink and blue stars, drifting like snowflakes.

bb2.text: The cloud hummed a low hum. It felt warm and friendly. Benjie hummed back at it.
bb2.art: bnjyboy at the rocket window inside the glowing star cloud, eyes wide, soft pink and blue light on his helmet.

bb3.text: One star shot past very fast. Behind it lay a dark patch. Something was hiding there.
bb3.art: A bright shooting star streaking across the star cloud with a quiet dark patch of space beyond it.

aaa1.text: He shone his torch down. The blue glow shone back. It was a pool of ice!
aaa1.art: bnjyboy shining a torch down into the crater, lighting up a smooth pool of pale blue ice at the bottom.

aaa2.text: Frozen water on the Moon. He had found something special. He drew it in his notebook.
aaa2.art: bnjyboy sitting on the crater rim drawing the blue ice pool in a small notebook, torch beside him.

aab1.text: He climbed down very carefully. The moon dust was soft. He landed with a puff.
aab1.art: bnjyboy climbing down the steep grey wall of the crater, moon dust puffing around his boots.

aab2.text: Inside was a cave of ice. It glowed soft and blue. It was the quietest place ever.
aab2.art: bnjyboy standing inside a glowing pale blue ice cave at the bottom of the crater, wonder on his face.

aba1.text: The rover rolled off slowly. Benjie hopped along behind. Its wheels made little tracks.
aba1.art: The small six-wheeled rover rolling across the grey Moon with bnjyboy hopping along behind it, tracks in the dust.

aba2.text: It stopped at a sunny ridge. Earth hung right above them. They watched it together.
aba2.art: bnjyboy and the little rover side by side on a moon ridge, the blue Earth hanging large in the black sky above.

abb1.text: One wheel was stuck fast. Benjie dug out the dust. He gave it a gentle push.
abb1.art: bnjyboy kneeling in the moon dust digging a stuck wheel free on the little rover.

abb2.text: The rover rolled forward again. All its lights blinked happily. It beeped a thank you.
abb2.art: The little rover rolling forward with all its lights lit, bnjyboy cheering with both arms up on the Moon.

baa1.text: The little moon was tiny. He could see all the way round. His steps were very bouncy.
baa1.art: bnjyboy bouncing high above the surface of a very small round moon, the ringed planet huge behind him.

baa2.text: One hop went very high. He floated slowly back down. He did it eleven more times.
baa2.art: bnjyboy floating slowly back down from a huge bounce on the tiny moon, arms out, laughing inside his helmet.

bab1.text: He stayed among the rings. He stepped out onto the ice. It was smooth as glass.
bab1.art: bnjyboy standing on a wide flat sheet of ring ice, glittering ice stretching away on all sides.

bab2.text: He slid along on his boots. Round and round he went. The best ice rink in space.
bab2.art: bnjyboy sliding across the smooth ring ice with his arms out like a skater, the ringed planet glowing behind him.

bba1.text: He chased the shooting star. It zoomed and looped about. It seemed to be playing.
bba1.art: bnjyboy's little rocket looping through space chasing a bright playful shooting star leaving a glittering trail.

bba2.text: At last it slowed right down. It circled his rocket twice. Then it lit up the way home.
bba2.art: The shooting star circling bnjyboy's rocket and lighting a bright path through the stars ahead.

bbb1.text: The dark patch was not empty. Something soft glowed inside. It was pink and very small.
bbb1.art: bnjyboy's rocket approaching a dark patch of space where a small soft pink glow shines in the middle.

bbb2.text: It was a brand new star. It was only just beginning. Benjie watched it start to shine.
bbb2.art: bnjyboy at his rocket window watching a tiny new pink star begin to glow brightly in the dark.
